《Stick》starring Wayne Wilson has a lot in common with "Ted Lasso," and Apple has just announced its return for a second season — with "Pluribus" star Rhea Seehorn joining the cast.

"Stick" Season 2 will premiere on November 4, with Rhea Seehorn joining the cast

After the Season 3 finale of "Ted Lasso," no one knew whether the show would return. Fortunately, fans of Lasso are in luck — a fourth season is already airing.

However, during its hiatus, Apple TV launched a new series that shares a lot of DNA with Lasso.

Wayne Wilson's "Stick" premiered last summer and was immediately compared to "Ted Lasso" — both being heartwarming sports comedies. Now, shortly after Lasso Season 4 wrapped up, "Stick" is set to return.

"Stick" Season 2 will premiere its first two episodes on Wednesday, November 4, with new episodes released weekly until December 30.

Here's the synopsis provided by Apple (no spoilers):

According to Apple's press release, the new season will see Santi taking the next step toward the professional golf world, while Pryce also returns to the sport.

The strong ensemble cast of "Stick" all returns for Season 2. Starring alongside Wilson are Peter Dager, Mark Maron, Mariana Treviño, Lily Kay, Judy Greer, and Timothy Olyphant.

"Pluribus" star Rhea Seehorn joins the cast as Pryce's new golf coach. New additions also include John Higgins, Billy Zane, Rex Lin, Sasha Alexander, and Mercy Park.

You can watch "Stick" Season 1 on Apple TV.

Are you a fan of "Stick"? Will you be tuning in for Season 2? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, or you can subscribe through the Apple One bundle deal.
